title: Uninstall
note: Project uninstall removes exact installer-owned checkout registration and folder trust only with exclusive ownership proof, including trust granted to the checkout's lanes, the Codex hook trust install minted for the checkout's hooks file and the copies mirrored onto its lanes. Trust Yoke did not record writing is neither changed nor reported; trust edited after Yoke wrote it stays and is reported without blocking completion. Shared or unproven registration is preserved. Machine uninstall shows a failed project step's named reasons. The removal commit records only files Git already tracked, so ignored local views stay out of history and strategy documents stay on disk untracked; the checkout mapping onboarding or install wrote counts as installer-owned. Partial cleanup keeps its manifest and .yoke/.gitignore, so the checkout stays clean and the same command retries to completion after the reported recovery. Machine uninstall remains a separate operation.
